body: Drake got surprised by a performance from The Backstreet Boys at his 40th birthday party Via: Drake got a birthday surprise from the Backstreet Boys The group treated him to a special performance during his birthday celebration, and his reaction says it all. Even after years of sharing stages with some of music’s biggest names, a surprise from the Backstreet Boys still had him saying, “Oh my God. ” Happy birthday, Drake!
